QUOTE: `StdioTransport::stderr_reader_loop` | `StdioTransport::open` | Drains child stderr ... `SSETransport::sse_reader_loop` | `SSETransport::open` | Reads the SSE stream
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both a stderr reader thread spawned by the stdio transport and an SSE reader thread spawned by the SSE transport.
